# AI Cues

> A prompt wallet: save cues you like and open them already filled in ChatGPT, Claude, Meta AI, and other AI tools.

AI Cues stores prompts you want to keep, then opens them in your favorite AI chat with the text already filled in. Sign in to sync, or continue as a guest on one device.

## Docs

- [Home](https://aicues.web.app/): product overview and how it works
